items.title: Abbott Laboratories (ABT) Posted Positive Trial Results For Two Heart Devices
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) reported positive one year VERITAS trial outcomes for its Amulet 360 device in atrial fibrillation patients. The Amulet 360 Left Atrial Appendage Occluder showed high safety and efficacy for stroke risk reduction in the VERITAS study. TECTONIC trial data indicated strong performance of Abbott's SonicForce Coronary IVL System in treating severe coronary artery calcification.
